'''Veré''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] character in a legend of<ref name="Databank" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]]<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> [[Futhork/Legends|Futhork]] [[Writing/Legends|calligraphy]] who was said to be eternal lovers with the male character [[Set]].<ref name="Databank" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]<ref name="JvS" /> adopted "Veré" and "Set" as their respective aliases in order to secretly [[Wedding of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala/Legends|join]] in [[Marriage/Legends|matrimony]].<ref name="Databank" />

The star-crossed lovers thus presented themselves to [[Pontifex/Legends|Pontifex]] [[Maxiron Agolerga/Legends|Maxiron Agolerga]] of the [[Brotherhood of Cognizance/Legends|Brotherhood of Cognizance]], who oversaw their marriage ceremony in the presence of the couple's [[Droid/Legends|droids]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], at the [[Varykino Villa/Legends|Varykino]] estate on Naboo. Aferward, "Set" [[Mind trick/Legends|instructed]] Agolerga not to speak of the ceremony, ensuring the only record of the short procession would be a scroll in his Brotherhood's archives.<ref name="Databank" /> When the holyman eventually learned of the couple's true identities, he informed Amidala's niece, [[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]], of the union.<ref name="JvS" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I remembered a story from 'Lord of the Rings' called 'The Tale of Beren and Lúthien' and transported this to the SW Galaxy. ''[&hellip;]'' What this legend is about remain''[s]'' untold. Were they happy? Did a tragedy occur? We might never know.|Tim Veekhoven|<ref name="Sompeetalay">{{Blog|teekay-421|13|They were the chosen ones}}</ref>}}
Veré was created by [[Tim Veekhoven]], writing as "Sompeetalay," for the character Maxiron Agolerga's [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry via the ''[[What's The Story?]]'' [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Databank" /> The entry was written in [[February]] [[2007]] and published in early [[2008]]. The eternal lovers' motif was borrowed from author [[Wikipedia:J. R. R. Tolkien|J. R. R. Tolkien's]] tale "[[W:c:lotr:Of Beren and Lúthien|Of Beren and Lúthien]],"<ref name="Sompeetalay" /> which details the romance between a mortal man named Beren and an Elf-maiden named Lúthien.<ref name="LOTR">{{BookCite|author=[[Wikipedia:J. R. R. Tolkien|Tolkien, J. R. R.]]|title=[[Wikipedia:The Silmarillion|The Silmarillion]]|contributor=[[Wikipedia:Christopher Tolkien|Christopher Tolkien]] (editor)|publisher=[[Wikipedia:Allen & Unwin|Allen & Unwin]]|date=1977}}</ref> Veekhoven stated that the name "Veré" was a common Naboo name and that Maxiron Agolerga was happy to officiate the wedding without caring that the couple used aliases.<ref name="Sompeetalay" />
